_comment: Responses ACTUALLY OBSERVED on 2026-08-03. The third entry has no path extension, so url-check asserts status only - guessing a content-type would invent a contract the source never offered.
_comment_spreadsheets: Added 2026-08-04, after the FOURTH surprise to this tool's fixture set. The .xls line is OBSERVED: the archived PPAC excise-tariff table cited by three phase-13 records answered 200 with application/vnd.ms-excel, and the gate called it a soft-404 because EXPECTED mapped .xls to the sentinel 'spreadsheet' - which matches only OOXML and can NEVER match a legacy workbook. The .xlsx line is NOT observed: no reachable .xlsx was found from this environment (rbidocs.rbi.org.in stalls in TLS handshake, recorded in the phase-13 research), so it pins the registered OOXML content type in order to prove the .xls fix did not break the modern branch. Fixture mode substitutes the response map for the fetch entirely, so neither line asserts anything about the network - each asserts what the predicate does with a given content-type, which is the whole of what is being pinned.
